digest.component_or_area: bridge CLI, engine request normalization, reconcile compatibility adapters
propositions: Canonical `rebar bridge preview` and `rebar bridge sync` become primary entrypoints while legacy `rebar reconcile` and `rebar.reconcile()` remain callable with backward-compatible defaults and filtering semantics.
Legacy `--filter-local-ids` applies post-differ write filtering; canonical `--only`/`--except` narrow differ inputs before execution; both coexist with distinct filtering points.
Direct-engine legacy calls retain live default; argument-less `rebar reconcile` and library/MCP reconcile remain dry-run by default; `--mode` values preserve documented behavior and exit codes.
`--max-changes` applies deterministic capped-manifest behavior with applied/deferred lists for values like 10 and 100, while uncapped live and legacy bootstrap remain unchanged.

Every `--only`/`--except` token must resolve to existing local ID or Jira key before lock acquisition; unresolved input exits 2 without lock or mutation; stale selections detected after lock also exit 2 before differ.

Production workflow retains `reconcile-check` as lock-free diagnostic while mapping dry-run/bootstrap-strict/bootstrap-throttle/live operations to canonical vocabulary; older checked-out workflows invoking legacy adapter paths remain functional.
